findings.message: Business rule task "Classify invoice" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:calledDecision or zeebe:taskDefinition.
User task "Approve invoice" is a job-worker user task; Camunda 8.10 deprecates those in favour of Camunda user tasks.
findings.suggestion: Add zeebe:userTask to make it a Camunda user task.

findings.message: User task "Approve invoice" has no zeebe:formDefinition.
findings.suggestion: Link a form (formId), an external form, or an embedded form.

findings.message: Service task "Archive invoice" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:taskDefinition.
Call activity "Book invoice" has no zeebe:calledElement processId.
findings.suggestion: Set the id of the process to call.

findings.message: Script task "Compute total" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:script or zeebe:taskDefinition.
